set.body:
Objective
Address units by immutable plan/split/replicate/stage/measurement coordinates and preserve typed completion/failure state. Make cancellation release only owned resources and retries contribute once.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements OPS-01, OPS-02, FND-06, FND-07. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
execution integration; frame/global execution adapters; existing pipeline/scheduling facilities. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M1.04, M1.03, M1.02. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Worker/traversal reorder preserves assignments and domain-separated random streams.
2. Injected failure after compute/before commit and duplicate retry cannot double-count reducer contributions or OOF rows.
3. Partial/cancelled inference remains incomplete rather than an apparently smaller complete family.
4. Supported checkpoint/resume verifies committed unit boundaries and compatibility; otherwise explicitly refuse resume. No new distributed runtime.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M3.10: Integrate deterministic work units, cancellation, and retry-safe reduction
